text:
maria_sales: Starting a HearthBank POC thread. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning with group sync, tenant domain locking and strict RBAC. Procurement asked for a hosted vs private cost comparison + security questionnaire answers. Can someone own the tech checklist and sec Qs?

arun_se: I can own the tech checklist and runbook. Quick clarifying q: will they provide an IdP test instance (Okta/Azure) or do we stand one up?

maria_sales: They will provide Okta staging tenant. Security wants private option pricing too.

priya_infosec: Heads up on the SQs: SOC2 type II, encryption specs, BYOK/KMS support, audit log retention (they asked for 13 months), pen test cadence, incident response contact, and SCIM attribute minimization. I'll start drafting.

arun_se: POC tech steps I propose:
1) Exchange SAML metadata and create a test SP on our side.
2) Provision 10 test users via SCIM delta sync.
3) Map SCIM groups to Redwood roles, test role-based actions (e.g., inference job approvals).
4) Validate domain lock: TXT proof verification flow.
5) Run failover simulation: hosted -> dedicated fallback under load.

arun_se: SCIM sample we send to IdP team:
```POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "userName": "alice@hearthbank.com",
  "externalId": "hb-001",
  "displayName": "Alice Q",
  "emails": [{"value": "alice@hearthbank.com"}],
  "groups": ["engineering", "platform-admins"]
}```

arun_se: RBAC mapping example: `platform-admins` -> `org_admin`; `engineering` -> `inference_dev`. We'll keep mapping explicit in the runbook.

tom_ae: Procurement asks: 8-week POC, ~200 rps peak (they said 200 reqs/min earlier, reconfirming). Want hosted estimate vs private reserved. Need two line-items with assumptions.

arun_se: Quick guesstimates: Hosted pay-as-you-go: $4k-$9k/month depending on model size and token use. Dedicated reserved (small pool e.g., 1-2 GPU class) ~ $28k/month committed for the period. Add Private (VPC) setup fee if on-prem access required.

priya_infosec: For the SQ I'll propose: encryption at rest with CMK option, TLS 1.2+ in transit, ability to redact request bodies from logs, 13 months audit retention (archival available), and regular third-party pen tests (annual). Need legal CMK wording for hosted from @legal_jess.

legal_jess: We can provide BYOK/KMS for enterprise. Legal needs the agreement clause text, but for a POC we can offer a limited BYOK attestation. I'll draft the clause.

maria_sales: Deploy-bot says the POC environment is ready. @deploy-bot any URL/creds?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Provisioned env `hearthbank-poc-us-west-2` (id: poc-990). Console: https://poc-hearthbank.redwood.example. Temporary creds in 1Password (shared with sales & SE).

maria_sales: Next actions: @arun_se create 1-page POC runbook + minimal test cases; include SAML metadata exchange steps, SCIM sample payloads, RBAC mapping table, and DNS TXT verification snippet. @priya_infosec draft SQ answers with the CMK option. @tom_ae put the two pricing lines into a short procurement note.

arun_se: ETA for runbook: tomorrow 10am PST. I'll include the RBAC CSV and sample curl for SCIM.

priya_infosec: ETA for security answers: tomorrow EOD. Looping legal for CMK language now.

tom_ae: I'll assemble the procurement note and send to Maria for review by EOD today.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll schedule a kickoff with HearthBank IdP and procurement for Wed. Thanks all.
